articles.summary: Banco Santander has been named the World's Best Bank by Euromoney in its prestigious ‘Awards for Excellence’, recognising the Group's transformation into a simpler, stronger and more connected global bank, underpinned by record results, disciplined capital allocation and sustained investment in technology and global platforms.
articles.title: Santander named the World’s Best Bank by Euromoney

articles.summary: In banking and capital markets, awards are about more than recognition – they provide a snapshot of market’s evolution, highlighting the transactions, solutions and institutions that are helping advance innovation and support economic growth.
articles.title: Beyond recognition: what industry awards say about Banking

articles.summary: Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) has successfully closed a USD 200 million Pre-Delivery Payment (PDP) facility with LATAM Airlines to finance the Pre-Delivery-Payments (PDP) of 23 new Airbus A320neo/A321neo aircraft, reinforcing a long-standing relationship with one of Latin America's leading airlines.
articles.title: Supporting LATAM Airlines’ fleet expansion
